outline:
本課程旨在提昇學生撰寫結構完整段落和短文之能力, 並著重如何重寫、摘要、 轉述、 陳述、筆記、編排、起草、修改等相關技巧。
This course is expected to expand students’ writing capacity and experience by helping them to formulate, organize, and present ideas clearly in well-formed paragraphs and compositions. Students will learn about rewriting, outlining, paraphrasing, synthesizing, documenting, note-taking, writing the draft and editing their own work.
schedule:
POETRY
Week 1: Focused Freewrites
Week 2: Dream Writing & Six Word Stories
Week 3: Intro to Poetry
Week 4: Poetry Lab
Week 5: Poetic Forms
Week 6: Poetic Devices I
Week 7: NO CLASS, Asynchronous Work
Week 8: Poetic Devices II
PERSONAL ESSAY
Week 9: Tension
Week 10: From Situation to Reflection
Week 11: Scene and Detail
Week 12: Reading Essays
Week 13: Cohesion and Coherence
Week 14: Revision
Week 15: Voice
Week 16: Precise Language & Cliché

category: 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
flexible_learning.content: In weeks 17–18, students review their writing and submit a 150–200-word reflection explaining one important writing decision, with a brief example, and one technique they would like to develop further.
flexible_learning.outcome: The reflection demonstrates students’ ability to respond thoughtfully to  and explain their own writing choices.

assessment:
Poem 25%
Personal Essay 30%
Participation and Workshop Practice 30%
Literary Event and Report 10%
Flexible Learning 5%
